verses.text: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
lines: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us,
but to your name give glory,
for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

verses.text: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
lines: Why should the nations say,
“Where is their God, now?”

verses.text: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
lines: But our God is in the heavens.
He does whatever he pleases.

verses.text: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
lines: Their idols are silver and gold,
the work of men’s hands.

verses.text: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.
lines: They have mouths, but they don’t speak.
They have eyes, but they don’t see.

verses.text: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.
lines: They have ears, but they don’t hear.
They have noses, but they don’t smell.

verses.text: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
lines: They have hands, but they don’t feel.
They have feet, but they don’t walk,
neither do they speak through their throat.

verses.text: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
lines: Those who make them will be like them;
yes, everyone who trusts in them.

verses.text: Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
lines: Israel, trust in Yahweh!
He is their help and their shield.

verses.text: House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
lines: House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh!
He is their help and their shield.

verses.text: You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
lines: You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh!
He is their help and their shield.

verses.text: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
lines: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us.
He will bless the house of Israel.
He will bless the house of Aaron.

verses.text: He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.
lines: He will bless those who fear Yahweh,
both small and great.

verses.text: May Yahweh increase you more and more, you and your children.
lines: May Yahweh increase you more and more,
you and your children.

verses.text: Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
lines: Blessed are you by Yahweh,
who made heaven and earth.

verses.text: The heavens are Yahweh’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
lines: The heavens are Yahweh’s heavens,
but he has given the earth to the children of men.

verses.text: The dead don’t praise Yah, neither any who go down into silence;
lines: The dead don’t praise Yah,
neither any who go down into silence;

verses.text: but we will bless Yah, from this time forward and forever more. Praise Yah!
lines: but we will bless Yah,
from this time forward and forever more.
Praise Yah!
